title: Postpartum haemorrhage in bad weather, Vaadhoo
story: 17:30, Vaadhoo. Postpartum bleeding. Presenter sets sea state 6.
proves: Sea modes disabled and the seaplane is past its sunset cutoff, so the engine shows its constraint reasoning (enable the helicopter in /demo to see the alternative).
intake_text: She gave birth at home an hour ago and is now bleeding heavily, soaked several towels in the last 15 minutes, she feels dizzy and weak.
presenter_notes: In /demo set Sea state 6. Speedboat and sea ambulance become infeasible and the seaplane is past the 17:15 last-landing cutoff. Toggle Helicopter on to show the only feasible option.
